overview: Based on the published agenda, this revised special Village Board meeting was scheduled to address personnel matters in closed session, including concerns regarding a former employee and a current employment issue. The meeting was set for August 18, 2026, at the Kronenwetter Municipal Center.

agenda.item: Closed session pursuant to Wisconsin Statutes 19.85(1)(c) and 19.85(1)(f) regarding specific concerns with a former employee and current personnel employment issue

discussions.item: Closed Session - Personnel and Employment Matters
discussions.body: The board was scheduled to convene in closed session to consider employment, compensation, and performance evaluation matters of public employees under Wisconsin Statute 19.85(1)(c), as well as disciplinary data and personnel problems under statute 19.85(1)(f). The closed session was set to address specific concerns regarding a former employee and a current personnel employment issue with possible action to follow.

actionItems: scheduled to convene in closed session to address personnel matters
expected to consider possible action regarding former and current employee concerns
title: REVISED Special Village Board Meeting - 2026-08-18
